step_s_reason: Must equal config/fire.json step_s. Stam 1999 uses fixed integration steps; 0.1 s is this simulation choice. https://graphics.stanford.edu/courses/cs468-05-fall/Papers/p121-stam.pdf
soot_yield_kg_kg_reason: Red oak flaming smoke yield in Table 1, Butler and Mulholland 2004, citing Tewarson SFPE Handbook data. This single wood surrogate does not represent all house fuels or underventilated combustion. https://tsapps.nist.gov/publication/get_pdf.cfm?pub_id=861149
extinction_m2_kg_reason: Mulholland and Croarkin 2000 report 8.7 m2/g at visible wavelength, with 95 percent uncertainty 1.1 m2/g. Multiply by 1000 g/kg. NISTIR 6588 p. 415 repeats the result. https://doi.org/10.1002/1099-1018(200009/10)24:5<227::AID-FAM742>3.0.CO;2-9 https://nehrpsearch.nist.gov/static/files/NIST/PB2001101517.pdf
upper_gas_density_kg_m3_reason: Constant hot mixture density estimate at about 391 K from 1.2 kg/m3 at 293 K by ideal gas scaling. This is carrier gas, not soot concentration. CFAST motivates two zones but does not prescribe this constant. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.TN.1889v1
lower_gas_density_kg_m3_reason: Ambient air mixture density estimate near 293 K. The lower/upper density ratio expands entrained air into the hot zone. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.TN.1889v1
plume_entrainment_m3_kj_reason: Estimated entrained ambient-air volume per kJ of retained fire heat, matching gas.entrainment_m3_s_kw in config/fire.json. Multiplication by lower/upper density converts to hot gas volume. Not a fitted CFAST plume correlation. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.TN.1889v1
smoke_diffusion_m2_s_reason: Estimated unresolved turbulent scalar diffusion, not molecular soot diffusivity. Implicit Gauss-Seidel follows Stam 1999. https://graphics.stanford.edu/courses/cs468-05-fall/Papers/p121-stam.pdf
kinematic_viscosity_m2_s_reason: Estimated effective momentum diffusion at the 0.25 m grid scale, not the molecular viscosity of air. Implicit Gauss-Seidel follows Stam 1999. https://graphics.stanford.edu/courses/cs468-05-fall/Papers/p121-stam.pdf
diffusion_iterations_reason: Fixed Gauss-Seidel sweeps give deterministic work. Component mass correction removes finite-iteration scalar mass error. Numerical choice, not a measured material property.
pressure_iterations_reason: Fixed Gauss-Seidel pressure sweeps on the aperture-weighted face Laplacian. Numerical cost/accuracy choice; residual divergence remains at finite iteration count.
min_lower_depth_m_reason: Numerical lower-zone volume floor. When upper carrier gas exceeds available volume, proportional upper soot spills into the lower zone. Estimate, not a CFAST calibration.
flame_mixing_per_s_reason: Estimated concentration-equalizing exchange near cells with retained heat release. Transfers soot between layers without creating or deleting mass.
interface_mixing_per_s_reason: Estimated concentration-equalizing exchange when the interface reaches the minimum lower-zone depth. Conserves total soot mass.
vent_exchange_m_s_reason: Estimated bidirectional exterior exchange speed, matching the 0.4 m3/s per metre width coefficient in config/fire.json when opening height is 1 m. Applied over each layer depth plus projected outward velocity. Outside replacement air has zero soot.
max_advection_speed_m_s_reason: Numerical bound on reconstructed transport velocity. At 0.1 s and 0.25 m cells this limits backtraces to 1.2 cells per axis. Face projection itself is not clipped.
snapshot_interval_steps_reason: Save smoke and face-velocity state every 2 s. A retained rewind replays at most 19 steps. The monotone private FireSim supplies cached sparse heat releases during replay.
snapshot_count_reason: Retain at most 32 checkpoints and heat history between them, about 62 s at the default stride. Older queries rebuild from zero. Bounds memory instead of retaining the whole run.
model_note: Two-dimensional ceiling flow with upper/lower soot masses and advected hot carrier volume. Aperture overlap preserves door/window clear width below one cell. Closed openings have zero leakage. Openings span both model layers; door heads and window sills are not resolved vertically. In sealed components a uniform compensating return divergence balances plume injection. No gas energy equation, oxygen limitation, soot deposition, wind, runtime hinge motion or pressure-driven structural leakage. This is a reduced fluid model, not NIST CFAST or validated fire-safety CFD. Heat of combustion comes directly from FireSim config/fire.json, currently 18000 kJ/kg. Density is 3 times visible extinction per metre and is not clamped to one. Sources accessed 2026-10-21.
